chapters.title: Why SharePoint got a bad reputation
Governance policies for SharePoint and Teams

takeaways: SharePoint's bad reputation stems mostly from missing information architecture and IT-driven intranets rather than from the platform itself.
Simple governance such as site request forms with business justification, periodic usage and permission reviews, and controlled versioning keeps SharePoint and Teams manageable.

Copilot makes SharePoint the main knowledge source of the organization, so basic metadata and well-governed content directly improve AI answers, while Power Automate remains the choice for deterministic processes.
hook: SharePoint has long been seen as complicated and boring, but Copilot turns it into the knowledge layer of the modern workplace. In this conversation, MVP Marcin Siewnicki shares practical advice for IT pros, intranet owners and governance teams on information architecture, sprawl, metadata and permissions. You will learn what to fix before AI arrives and how Copilot, agents and Power Automate fit together.
